Acme Robotics is hiring an AI Automation Engineer.

You will build RAG pipelines and LLM agents for our support desk. Our RAG stack
runs on Kubernetes, and you will own the RAG evaluation harness. Experience with
Kubernetes and Terraform is required; Kubernetes on-call is shared.

What you will do:
- Ship LLM agents that triage support tickets.
- Build data pipelines in Python and PostgreSQL.
- Write clear documentation for every LLM workflow.
- Improve the document search service and its data pipelines.

We offer a competitive salary, great benefits and a strong team culture.
